The `*` and `%` meta-characters can appear multiple times in the pattern. To match wildcards at the beginning or end of the pattern, use `*` to match any single character or `%` to match a sequence of characters. If using a phone number, it must be a Twilio number or a Verified [outgoing caller id](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/api/outgoing-caller-ids) for your account.
